purpose: Teach: 車輪/離陸/発車/発せ/呼び出さ/乗り込み/買い求め/現況

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、産業用車輪の摩耗研究を続けろ
lines.en: Ren, keep pushing forward with the industrial wheel wear research.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Spoken as fact, not question. Brief pause before the name—eye contact establishing. Confident in Ren's competence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。航空機の離陸性能の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep reading the aeronautical takeoff performance papers.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Slight lean forward. Respectful but not deferential—showing he's already thought this through. Small nod on the intake breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、新幹線の発車制御の研究を深めろ
lines.en: Ren, deepen your research on the Shinkansen departure control systems.
lines.style: Firm, specific emphasis on 「深めろ」—not just doing it, going deeper. Seated authority, unrushed. The kind of direction that trusts the person to rise to it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で警報音が発せられた事例を学びます
lines.en: Yes. I'll study the case studies where alarm systems were triggered at conferences.
lines.style: Faster intake breath—small sign of being engaged, energized by the concrete task. Notes being taken internally. Respectful straightness in posture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室で呼び出される時の対応を整えろ
lines.en: Ren, prepare your response protocol for when you're called into the lab.
lines.style: Practical, almost protective in its specificity. Not demanding—organizing. Slight warmth underneath, the mentorship showing in the care of the detail.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。現地調査へ早めに乗り込み準備をします
lines.en: Yes. I'll get on-site early and be ready for any field surveys.
lines.style: Quick, efficient agreement. Small nod on 「はい」. Not overthinking—just moving. The eagerness of a student who finally gets to do the real work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、必要な実験器具を遠慮なく買い求めろ
lines.en: Ren, don't hesitate—buy whatever experimental equipment you need.
lines.style: Permission wrapped as directive. Slight lean back in chair—giving space for the student to take this seriously. Warmth in the dismissal of constraint.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の現況を月一で報告します
lines.en: Yes. I'll report on the research progress once a month.
lines.style: Soft close. Slower tempo. The 「はい」carries gratitude underneath. Slight exhale—relief and resolve settling together. Almost a promise.
